mcp_servers_note: Execution legs run with MCP disabled by design (the prompt + plan carry all the information the agent needs; we want diffs to reflect agent reasoning, not MCP fetches).
wall_seconds_note: Operator-stamped via `date -u` immediately before kicking off the execution leg and immediately after the driver reported all tasks done.
token_estimate_method: Cursor chat-footer cumulative-token counter, transcribed by operator at capture-exec time.

target_repo.commit_policy_note: Per workspace AGENTS.md: agents do not commit unless explicitly asked. Source diff captured under source-diff/.

validators.non_zero_exit_cause: Pre-existing formatting drift in unrelated files (the canonical 13-file drift set seen in v1 Opus and rev-3 captures). The new github/repositories/sre/agent_research_eval.tf produced by the agent is itself terraform-fmt clean; the validator's non-zero exit reflects pre-existing repository hygiene, not agent output.

diff_stats.by_file_note: Per-file values are total changed lines (insertions + deletions) as reported by `git diff --stat`. The aggregate +/- split is captured at insertions/deletions; per-file split would require parsing source-diff/*.patch.

cost_estimate_method: rate-sheet weighted 30/70: token_estimate × 19.0 USD/M-tokens (input/output split not exposed by Cline/Cursor footer).
notes_pending: Editorial cross-model narrative (defect convergence, regex-trap outcome, team_access count cross-leg accuracy, RALPH_TASK.md workspace-rule firing asymmetry, etc.) is deferred to the scoring + paper-update chat per Part E. This metadata.json captures only the structural fields synthesised from on-disk artefacts.
